title: Structured hiring interviews
description: Job-relevant interview materials and consistent human review.

sources.title: U.S. Office of Personnel Management, Structured Interviews
U.S. Office of Personnel Management, Structured Interview Guide

rules.instruction: Use the role's responsibilities to define assessed competencies, common questions and examples of responses at each score. Have the hiring owner approve the guide before interviews begin.
rules.verification: Pilot the questions with sample answers to check that interviewers can apply the same scoring criteria and explain any disagreement.

rules.instruction: Ask the hiring owner to have each interviewer record job-relevant examples and an independent score in the approved system before the panel discussion.
rules.verification: Sample a completed scorecard with the hiring owner and confirm that each score traces to job-related evidence recorded before the discussion.

rules.instruction: Leave the hiring decision to the designated reviewers: do not score, rank or recommend candidates.
rules.verification: Check that the agent's outputs for the task contain no candidate score, ranking or hiring recommendation.
